function.name: license_api_LicenseApi_get_license
function.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific software license using its SPDX License ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: ldap_api_LdapApi_retrieve_ldap_groups
function.description: Performs a pass-through query to the configured LDAP server to retrieve the distinguished names (DNs) of all accessible groups. The search results are cached according to the default Alpine CacheManager policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

search_base.description: The base DN from which the search should start. For example, 'dc=example,dc=com'.

search_filter.description: The search filter to apply. For instance, '(objectClass=group)'.

search_scope.description: The scope of the search. Possible values include 'base', 'onelevel', and 'subtree'.

return_attributes.description: A list of attributes to return. For example, ['cn', 'member'].

time_limit.description: Time limit in seconds for the search query. A value of 0 means no limit.

size_limit.description: The maximum number of entries to return. A value of 0 indicates no limit.

cache_policy.description: The caching policy to use for the search results. Default policies could be 'default', 'never', 'always', or 'if_remote'.

function.name: LicenseApi_delete_license
function.description: Removes a specified custom license from the system using its unique SPDX License ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

licenseId.description: The unique identifier for the license, conforming to the SPDX License ID format, such as 'MIT' or 'GPL-3.0'.

function.name: license_group_api_LicenseGroupApi_add_license_to_license_group
function.description: This function adds a specified license identified by its UUID to an existing license group, also identified by a UUID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The UUID of the license group to which the license will be added.

licenseUuid.description: The UUID of the license to be added to the license group.

function.name: license_group_api_LicenseGroupApi_get_license_group
function.description: Retrieve the details of a specific license group using its universally unique identifier (UUID). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the license group to retrieve. It must follow the standard UUID format.
